headline: Roll20 says an outsider reached account records for under 1% of users on Nov 16, including password hashes.
summary: First draft. 2 sources (1 Tier 1), 17 claims (10 Confirmed, 2 Reported, 5 Not established), 7 questions. Roll20's forum notice confirms the intrusion; the upload-flaw detail is from its email via one outlet. No attacker named. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles.
author: Research agent
